Weekly Traffic Advisory

NYC DOT posts a weekly list of streets, bridges, highways, and tunnels that are temporarily closed for planned construction activities, special events, parades, and other events permitted by NYC DOT. This information is subject to change including all event dates, times, and routes, and does not reflect closures due to emergency situations nor long-term construction projects.

Weekly Traffic Advisory for Saturday October 31, 2026, to Friday November 6, 2026

The City of New York’s Department of Transportation issued a traffic advisory for the following locations.

*Note: Bold text indicates updated information.

  • East River Bridge and Tunnel Crossings
  • Manhattan
  • Bronx
  • Staten Island

Manhattan

Battery Park Underpass

As of Sunday October 25th, 2026, through Friday November 20th, 2026, a full northbound and southbound tube will continue to be closed (not at the same time), will take place every week 10pm Sunday night to 5am Friday morning.

Southbound Route 9A between West 30th Street and West 26th Street

One out of three southbound lanes will be closed on Saturdays from 12:01am to 9am, and two out of three from 1am to 6am on Sundays.

Traffic will return to its original configuration each morning.

2026 Abbott Dash To The Finish Line 5K

The following streets will be closed Saturday October 31st, 2026, for the 2026 Abbott Dash To The Finish Line 5K.

Embargo: Special Event Construction Embargo / October 22nd, 2026, to October 31st, 2026

Location(s):
  • East 47th Street between 1st Avenue and 2nd Avenue
  • 1st Avenue between East 50th Street and East 42nd Street
  • 42nd Street between 1st Avenue and 6th Avenue

Bronx

Hutchinson River Parkway Bridge over the Hutchinson River

As of Monday October 26th, 2026, through Friday November 13th, 2026, the Bronx-bound right lane will be closed from 7am to 3pm, additionally, alternating lane closures will occur.

Bruckner Expressway at Hunts Point Avenue

The exit will be closed intermittently Monday nights to Friday mornings from 10pm to 5am until May 12, 2027, to facilitate NYCDOT-Bridges removal and installation of steel beams.

Staten Island

Front Street between Wave Street and Hannah Street

This street will be closed from 7am to 6pm Monday to Friday through December 20, 2026 for new Stapleton waterfront infrastructure.

Front Street/Murray Hubert Avenue between Thompson Street and Bay Street

This street will be closed from 7am to 6pm Monday to Friday through December 20, 2026 for new Stapleton waterfront infrastructure.
